Prophecy: The Earth Shall Swallow Korah's Company
ProphecySummary: Moses sets a test: if Korah, Dathan and Abiram die a common death, the LORD has not sent him, but if the LORD makes a new thing and the earth opens her mouth and swallows them alive into the pit, then they have provoked the LORD.
Fulfillment: Fulfilled immediately in Numbers 16:31-33: as Moses finishes speaking, the ground cleaves asunder under them, the earth opens her mouth and swallows them, their houses, and all the men that appertained to Korah.
RelatedPeople: Moses; Aaron; Korah, Son of Izhar; Dathan; Abiram
